note: Review-only companion; not a TestsData row. Full distractor-specific and technical final review still recommended before live insert.

questions.text: A PC powers on, but no image appears on the monitor. Which first check best isolates a simple connection issue?

options.label: B
options.text: Check monitor power, selected input and video cable seating

questions.rationale: Power/input/cable checks can identify basic display connection problems.

questions.text: A motherboard has an available compatible expansion slot and a task needs extra graphics capability. Which installation concept applies?

options.label: A
options.text: Place the card in a RAM slot

options.label: B
options.text: Replace the power socket with a serial port

options.label: C
options.text: Install a compatible graphics expansion card

options.label: D
options.text: Connect the monitor to the microphone jack

questions.rationale: A compatible graphics card uses an appropriate motherboard expansion slot.

questions.text: A file server needs more storage capacity but should keep the existing drive. Which syllabus procedure is relevant?

options.label: D
options.text: Install a second hard drive after checking compatibility and power/data connections

questions.rationale: The syllabus includes installation of a second hard drive.

questions.text: An older peripheral offers only a serial interface, while a computer has no built-in serial port. What must be checked before connecting it?

options.label: A
options.text: Whether a suitable compatible interface/adapter and driver are supported

options.label: B
options.text: Whether the monitor brightness is high enough

options.label: D
options.text: Whether a keyboard uses rubber domes

questions.rationale: Interface compatibility and driver support determine whether it can communicate.

questions.text: A printer must create a multi-part form by striking an ink ribbon. Which type best fits that requirement?
questions.rationale: Dot-matrix printers use impact through an ink ribbon.

questions.text: A user sees faint output from an inkjet printer. Which check is more relevant than changing the monitor?

options.label: A
options.text: Inspect ink levels and printhead/nozzle condition

questions.rationale: Ink supply and printhead condition directly affect inkjet output.

questions.text: A keyboard key repeats or fails. Which hardware maintenance sequence is safest?

options.label: A
options.text: Pour liquid into the keyboard while connected

options.label: B
options.text: Disconnect power, inspect/clean according to the keyboard design, then reassemble and test

options.label: C
options.text: Short all pins to test the switch

questions.rationale: Safe cleaning starts with disconnection and uses the appropriate procedure.

questions.text: A laptop overheats during ordinary use and its fan outlet is blocked by fabric. What should be done first?

options.label: D
options.text: Move it to a hard, unobstructed surface and check ventilation

questions.rationale: Unblocking air intake/exhaust helps restore cooling.

questions.text: A storage comparison must consider how quickly data can move after a drive is active. Which metric is most relevant?
questions.rationale: Transfer rate measures data moved per unit time.

questions.text: A storage upgrade must preserve files already on a drive. Which sequence is safest before partition/format operations?

options.label: B
options.text: Delete the backup to avoid confusion

options.label: C
options.text: Back up and verify the target drive and partition before making changes

options.label: D
options.text: Select a partition by capacity alone without checking

questions.rationale: Backup and target verification reduce the risk of destructive mistakes.
